messages:
Rachel: Sapphire Systems EAP NDA signed this morning. Need to lock bench plan and telemetry whitelist.
Devon: Sweet. Partner asked for focus on int8 perf and cold-start for conversational loads.
Sapphire-poc: We'll ship 6 dev units next Tue and upload driver `sapphire-rt-2026.img` + container `sapphire/ref:2026-05` to our portal.
Legal-bot: NDA countersigned. Forbidden telemetry: microcode, JTAG, full kernel traces. Allowed: perf counters, memory stats, limited dmesg.
Nate: Bench plan proposal: (1) cold-start chat (prompt+sampling) (2) steady-state throughput sweep (3) int8 accuracy check. Use `benchctl`.
Ops-Kim: Need exact commands & image SHA to template infra job and egress exception for partner portal.
Nate: Example run commands:
```
benchctl run --model rwd-chat-13b --mode cold --seq 256 --batch 1 --out s3://bench/sapphire/1856004321/cold
benchctl run --model rwd-chat-13b --mode throughput --seq 1024 --batch 32 --out s3://bench/sapphire/1856004321/throughput
benchctl run --model rwd-chat-13b --mode quant-check --quant int8 --out s3://bench/sapphire/1856004321/quant
```
Rachel: Important: scrub any firmware traces before upload. Use `--strip-firmware` and `--anonymize` flags. Legal will verify partner copy.
Sapphire-poc: We'll provide power sensor access and a helper script to normalize readings. Also will share one-time creds via vault for image download.
Bench-bot: Latency sweep queued on infra-gpu-9. Est runtime 2.2h. Artifacts will land at s3://bench/sapphire/1856004321/meta.json
Bench-bot: Latency pass complete: seq32 p50=3.1ms/token p99=10.2ms/token; seq512 p50=12.5ms/token p99=48.7ms/token. Throughput baseline 2180 tok/s (fp16). Int8 pass queued.
Devon: Those look good. Nate, please stash raw CSVs for internal analysis and produce a scrubbed partner report.
Nate: Will generate internal + partner variants. Partner report will omit kernel traces and microcode fields.
Ops-Kim: I'll provision egress rule and bake the golden container. Ping when image SHA is available.
Rachel: Action items: (1) Sapphire upload driver/container (sapphire-poc), (2) Ops bake image + egress (ops-kim), (3) Nate run int8 + scrubbed report, (4) Legal sign-off on partner copy. Quick sync Fri 9am PT to review results.
Sapphire-poc: Noted. We'll aim to have artifacts and docs ready before the sync.
Bench-bot: Int8 pass complete: throughput=1920 tok/s, p50=14.8ms/token, p99=62ms/token. Summary -> s3://bench/sapphire/1856004321/summary.json
Rachel: Thanks team. If any blockers, post here or DM. :rocket:
